messages:
jin: quick heads-up — prepping the weight handoff for maverick-13b, dropped a tarball to s3://redwood-models/maverick/13b/v1/. noticed tokenizer.json from the repo has an extra <|pad|> token compared to the runtime tokenizer. can someone confirm which to use?

maria: looking now. is that the file at s3://redwood-models/maverick/13b/v1/tokenizer.json or the one in the repo under models/maverick/13b/tokenizer.json? we had two copies during conversion.

jin: s3 one (the artifact). repo one is still the legacy from convert step. runtime currently loads by digest (sha256) and expects no <|pad|>.

alex: I ran a quick tokenization diff earlier — the s3 tokenizer maps <|pad|> -> id 0 which shifts all offsets. downstream attention masks for sliding-window inference break because of that shift. short-term fix: remap ids in the runtime loader with a compatibility flag.

sam: are we sure it's just id-shift and not different merges/splits? we saw weird token splits on punctuation in a previous conversion.

maria: confirmed: merges identical. it's only the extra token at the front. easiest is to set `tokenizer_offset_compat: true` when serving this model. that will subtract 1 from IDs > 0.

jin: perfect. will add flag to the model config. also noticed config.yml uses `use_gqa: auto` which runtime rejects (expects true/false). the model was converted with llama-convert v3 which leaves auto.

alex: please change to `use_gqa: true` for this model — the weight layout is grouped for grouped-query-attention. if mismatch, attention kernel will crash on init (seen an OOM in staging).

maria: do we need to adjust rope scaling? maverick was trained with RoPE scaling 0.8 (linear). config.yml currently lacks `rope_scale`. runtime default is 1.0 which will degrade recency.

jin: add `rope_scale: 0.8` to config.yml. also enable `rope_mode: linear` explicitly.

sam: for sliding window, set `sliding_window.stride: 512` and `sliding_window.max_ctx: 16384`? what were the training segs?

maria: training used 16k windows with 512 stride — yes. runtime should set `kv_cache.segment_size: 2048` to avoid excessive reallocation for long chat sessions.

alex: FYI, deploy-bot will run the compatibility linter as soon as you push the config. it checks: tokenizer offset, use_gqa boolean, rope_scale present, and sliding_window keys.

deploy-bot: [lint] model config lint starting for maverick-13b v1 — running checks: tokenizer-offset, gqa-flag, rope-scale, sliding-window.

jin: I'll push a patched config in a sec. patch will include this snippet:

```
# model config
use_gqa: true
rope_mode: linear
rope_scale: 0.8
tokenizer_offset_compat: true
sliding_window:
  max_ctx: 16384
  stride: 512
kv_cache:
  segment_size: 2048
```

maria: looks good. after lint, can we run a quick smoke serve on a single GPU with `--attention=flash` and `--validate-attn` to exercise kernels?

alex: do that. add `--gqa-layout=packed` flag when starting runtime so kernel picks the right indexing.

sam: if lint passes and smoke serve is OK, I'll roll a canary to staging with 5% traffic and latency SLOs enabled. add a canary eval harness with these prompts: short Q/A, long-context summarization, and prefix continuation.

jin: done — pushed config and manifest to s3 (manifest at s3://redwood-models/maverick/13b/v1/manifest.json), kicked the lint.

deploy-bot: [lint] tokenizer-offset: OK; gqa-flag: OK; rope-scale: OK; sliding-window: OK; kv-cache: OK.

maria: great. starting the smoke serve now. I'll post logs if anything flakes.

alex: if you hit the attention kernel crash, attach the stderr and `dmesg` output. the crash usually shows `invalid_index` in packed_gqa.cu.

jin: thanks all. will monitor canary and follow-up with perf numbers. :thumbsup:
